messages.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE AS activity_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) AS lead_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN counsellor_remarks.remark_count > 30 THEN counsellor_remarks.counsellor_id END) AS counsellors_with_more_than_30_remarks
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        counsellor_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE AS remark_date,
        COUNT(remark_id) AS remark_count
    FROM student_remarks
    WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY counsellor_id, DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
) counsellor_remarks ON DATE_TRUNC('day', s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE = counsellor_remarks.remark_date
WHERE s.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::DATE
ORDER BY activity_date DESC;
